use: Called out by staff as you walk into a shop or restaurant; customers don't reply, a nod is enough.

example.ja: いらっしゃいませ！何名様ですか？
example.english: Welcome! How many in your party?

notes: At someone's home you'll hear irasshai (come on in).

use: Staff and hosts use it about your coming: yoku okoshi kudasaimashita (thanks for coming), mata no okoshi o omachi shite orimasu (please come again).

example.romaji: mata no okoshi o omachi shite orimasu.
example.ja: またのお越しをお待ちしております。
example.english: We look forward to seeing you again.

notes: Never use it about yourself; for your own visit say ukagaimasu.

use: Staff's polite word for your order; for your own order you just say chuumon.

example.ja: ご注文はお決まりですか？

notes: To ask for more time: mou sukoshi matte kudasai.
